messages:
maya: Heads-up — I pushed zephyr-v2-ptq (int8) to the canary group. Getting a noticeable uptick in funcall JSON parse failures on tool-heavy prompts. sample failure attached below.

sam: Can you paste the raw generated output? Is this only on int8 or on fp16 canary too?

maya: Pasting one example (trimmed):
```
{
  "tool": "search",
  "args": {"q": "electron mobility",},
  "meta": {"request_id": "abc-123"
```
(note the trailing comma and missing closing brace)

jordan: Looks like suffix truncation + extra-comma. Could be streaming boundary or kv-cache prefixing pushing out the final tokens. Which runtime kernels/quant flags were used?

maya: Canary config: batch_size=8, continuous_batching=true, kv_prefix_combine=true, max_gen_tokens=512, quant_mode=ptq-int8, kernel=auto-select (A100). FP16 canary had ~99% parse success; int8 is ~93% on same dataset.

ciara: I pulled canary-bot logs: canary-bot: "stream-chunk-drop detected for request abc-123, last_chunk_len=2, saw EOS token index -1" — looks like the stream ended mid-JSON for ~7% of requests.

sam: Repro plan: 1) disable continuous_batching 2) run with kv_prefix_combine=false 3) set batch_size=1 4) instrument raw token stream for a few requests. If parse success jumps, we know batching/kvcache is the culprit.

maya: Starting those runs now on the canary pool. kicking off 500-sample smoke with batch_size=1 and kv_prefix=false.

jordan: Also suggestion: add a light repair fallback in the funcall parser for the canary (try trailing bracket insertion + JSON5 tolerant parse). We can AB test repair on 10% of failing requests to measure false-positive repairs.

ciara: I'll create a feature flag: ml/json-repair-heuristic-v2 and wire it to canary. canary-bot: created flag ml/json-repair-heuristic-v2 -> rollout 10%.

maya: Quick interim numbers: with batching disabled parse success increased to 98.6% on the sample. kv_prefix=false gave similar improvement. Looks like batching interactions with int8 kv-cache is the primary suspect.

sam: Great signal. Next steps: file a kernel/kvcache bug with runtime team, keep the repair heuristic gated behind the feature flag, and schedule a quant re-run with alternative calibration to see if token-level representation shifts matter.

jordan: Also add a test in the onboarding harness that runs toolcall prompts through the actual streaming path under int8 quant and asserts >=99% parse success for the pinned prompt set.

maya: Agreed. I'll open an onboarding PR with the test and link the canary logs. Will post results in this thread when the kernel team responds. :thumbsup:

canary-bot: Canary rollout note — zephyr-v2-ptq: 20% -> 20% (no config change), repair-flag: ml/json-repair-heuristic-v2 at 10%

ciara: tagging @runtime-team in the ticket. ticket: RUNTIME-8762.

maya: Thanks everyone — I'll update once we have kernel trace and the PR.
